profile.statement: I turn complex business rules into software that is simple to use.
profile.bio: Full stack software engineer with 3 years of experience, currently working as a Pleno engineer on an integrated retail management software, where I work with PHP and Laravel on the backend and React and TypeScript on the frontend. I maintain Herbst UI, an open source Angular component library. Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering and currently pursuing Computer Science at IFMA.

experience.title: Pleno Software Engineer
experience.place: Voreli · Integrated Retail Management Software · Imperatriz, MA
highlights: Moving the system to the platform's second generation without stopping customer operations, migrating data and rules module by module to a domain-based modular architecture.
Building the backend in PHP and Laravel following Cruddy by Design: lean controllers on REST verbs and business logic isolated in actions.
Supporting ERP, POS, tax, inventory, finance, CRM, e-commerce and recurring billing in a single product.
Keeping domains independent from each other, with layer boundaries validated automatically and architecture decisions recorded in ADRs.
Took heavy operations out of the user's response time with Redis queues and events, plus route and database query optimization.
Delivered the product's screens in React and TypeScript on top of an in-house Design System.
Block regressions before merge with TDD in Pest, Vitest and Playwright, CI/CD on GitHub Actions and monitoring with Sentry.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
experience.place: Zeta Coders · Online courses and e-commerce platform · Imperatriz, MA
highlights: Launched the learning area and the e-commerce in the same system, with REST APIs and business rules in Express.
Delivered screens that work on desktop and mobile, turning Figma flows into React interfaces.
Standardized the team's development and deployment environments with Docker.

experience.title: Volunteer Developer
highlights: Delivered junior enterprise projects as a developer, working in teams with shared tasks.
Unblocked early-career peers by answering technical questions and reviewing code.

experience.title: Full Stack Web Developer
experience.place: Freelance · Projects for end clients · Remote
highlights: Delivered production REST APIs for end clients, with role-based access control, in Java with Spring Boot and in NestJS.
Kept each client's rules on consistent foundations, modeling data in MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Led projects end to end, from requirements to deployment, with React and Angular interfaces and CI/CD pipelines.

herbst-ui.name: Herbst UI
herbst-ui.description: Angular component library where the code is yours: the CLI copies each component into your project, with no locked-in dependency. Documentation in Portuguese and English, with live examples and light and dark themes.

literium.name: Literium
literium.description: Book e-commerce prototyped in Figma: a React SPA with user sessions and a Spring Boot API for users, books, categories, orders and favorites, with JWT authentication.

vortex.name: Vortex Bank
vortex.description: Digital bank with accounts, wallets, transactions and real-time notifications over WebSocket. The Spring Boot API uses JWT, AES encryption and Flyway migrations; the Next.js app has a landing page and a logged-in area.

trips.name: Trip planner
trips.description: Angular app for planning trips: create and edit trips, participants, search and status for each trip, with data saved in the browser.

ecommerce.name: Santander Coders E-commerce
ecommerce.description: Store built in TypeScript with no framework, with custom components, a filterable catalog, cart and JWT login consuming an API.
